title: Koh Samet: finding her way
kaylee: On Koh Samet she always knows which beach she's on and how to reach the next one, and the taxi takes her where she wants. Pick how her finger finds the way.
questions: Leaving Koh Samet moves to the speedboat at the pier (tap it, then the home picture). OK?

pitches.title: Kaylee's Island Map
pitches.finger: Open her toy map, tap a beach, follow the glowing shells.
grows: tap a beach, follow the shells
far ones: the shells hop in the taxi
her flags and animals fill the map
pitches.learns: Reading a map: where she is, which beach is which.
pitches.silly: Tap the sea on the map: a whale splashes out.
pitches.why: A map that fills with her pink flags is her own trophy board.
also: Top-left button: her map, her pin always on it
Taxi: tap a beach on its map, it drives straight there

pitches.title: Follow the Beach Puppy
pitches.finger: Tap the puppy and chase him to a beach she hasn't played.
grows: chase him to the next beach
his shortcuts: a sand slide, a rope swing
pitches.learns: Beach names: he barks each one when they arrive.
pitches.silly: Run the other way: he runs back and tugs her tail.
pitches.why: She loves a friend who needs her, and he's a puppy.
also: Top-left button: the puppy, tap and he comes
Taxi: he jumps in, it drives where he wants

pitches.title: The Sun Bear's Taxi Bell
pitches.finger: Ride the taxi, pull the bell when her beach's picture glows.
grows: the pelican's longtail boat has a bell too
pitches.learns: Island life: green taxis, beach names, counting stops.
pitches.silly: Ring and ring: the sun bear sings along.
pitches.why: A small win at every stop, and the whole island from the taxi.
also: Top-left button: the horn, the taxi comes to her
Every beach: a big picture sign that says its name
